title: Plt export
content:
Hi CLO Team,  
I have a feature request regarding the PLT / plotter export and multi-size pattern exports in general.  
When I use Arrange (disponi), before the layout is generated, all the sizes appear perfectly stacked on top of each other (as shown in the screenshot).  
But once the layout is created, the software automatically spreads all the sizes apart, creating separated pieces.  
For my workflow, it would be extremely helpful to have an option to export all sizes stacked, exactly as they appear before using Arrange — basically keeping the graded sizes overlapped.  
It would also be very useful to have an option to export a PDF with stacked sizes, not only DXF, since the DXF format often creates compatibility issues with some plotters and external software.  
In short:  
– the ability to export all graded sizes stacked exactly as they appear before using Arrange;  
– an additional PDF export mode with stacked graded sizes.  
This feature would be incredibly helpful for anyone working with full size-range pattern development.  
Thank you for your attention!![24ef7a774a794a41a1f5c266a7cab345](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/e060322d4db446f18b39596c61feb6e1/images/24ef7a774a794a41a1f5c266a7cab345IMG_8742.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello, you first need to make marker with desired size and fabric width and then export plt. Do not forget to add seam allowance.
content_description: This page serves to request enhanced export options for multi-size pattern layouts, enabling users to export stacked graded sizes in both DXF and PDF formats to improve workflow efficiency.

title: Problems with Graphics Card
content:
Dear Dears, I'm having major trouble finding a suitable desktop/laptop for CLO 3D. I already returned one laptop. With the NVIDIA GeForce 5070TI graphics card the program constantly crashes. Working is impossible. Support is looking into it, but I'm not very technically savvy and I'm not getting any concrete information about which graphics card runs stably. Can anyone give me a tip? Who has a laptop they're happy with and where CLO runs without crashing multiple times a day? Thanks a lot & merci beaucoup, Tina

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. It does look like our tech team has gone over a lot of support about your graphics card and updates. But if you have returned that computer and looking for another one. We do always recommend looking at our specs page - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2e642410059d4beebb4daf3c8d082950 also when looking at a computer we recommend looking at Gaming Specific Laptops
Reply 1: Hi,Yes,I’ve already been in contact with the CLO Support team several times, but unfortunately, I haven’t been able to make any progress. I did the updates and everything but the software crashed nonstop. My laptop meets all the system requirements listed on your website, yet CLO 3D keeps crashing regularly – sometimes up to ten times a day.I understand that these issues might be related to certain graphics card models. However, my device is a common gaming laptop equipped with a high-performance GPU. As an end user and not an IT expert, it’s very difficult for me to troubleshoot these technical problems on my own.I simply want to be able to work reliably with CLO 3D, but this hasn’t been possible for weeks. I hope you understand that it’s impossible to build a business under these conditions. And it dosen't really help to receive the same link to the minimum system requirements over and over again. I’ve described my problem here in the hope of getting some advice from the community. I hope that’s okay with you.
Reply 2: You have also asked about other computers. So we do recommend looking into gaming specific.As for CLO crashes I did not see any files from CLO attached so I am curious if you are following best practices? like a few mentioned below-Keeping Large pattern pieces at 20 Particle Distance while working/editing-Building Garments 1 at a time in their own files (not building several garments or a full look in 1 file). Always good to build on their own and combine once done-Are you applying prints/graphics that are too large and slowing down CLOThese are just a few random ideas above
content_description: A community forum page for users to share recommendations and experiences with laptops or desktops that run CLO 3D smoothly without crashing.

title: Render Issue
content:
![27d1298d3577482ea7439b527058e2e5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/673a2e1d9abf4b9b806956bbce096ffc/images/27d1298d3577482ea7439b527058e2e5Screenshot%202025-11-12%20at%2012.21.53.png)Hi everyone,  
I’m having an issue with rendering in CLO3D. Even though all my settings are the same as usual, the final render image looks blurry and doesn’t get sharp, no matter the resolution or quality level I choose.  
I’ve checked lighting, camera focus, and render settings, everything seems fine.  
Has anyone experienced this before or knows what might be causing it?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I would recommend you post all your render properties. But the one thing I see is your noise is set to 0.001. Which means likely our computer cannot finish with such a low level.I usually recommend setting noise to 0.030. I have found the if I render the same image at 0.030 and lower no one can actually visually see a difference. The only thing is going lower means you you need to increase render time and it just takes more time
Reply 1: Thank you !
content_description: A community forum page for CLO3D users to seek help and share solutions regarding rendering issues and software troubleshooting.

title: Graphics not showing base fabric texture
content:
Hello, I am new to Clo and trying apply a print to a fabric (with a normal map that I created of a unique fabric) but when I do this as you can see below on the front panel, the fabric map / texture doesn't show up. In the graphics properties I tried to add the normal map as per the fabric and made it have the same settings but this didn't work. I can see a lot of old posts about how to get sublimated garment graphics showing properly but I am not sure on the latest versions how to do this (2025.1.236). Any help would be greatly appreciated!

![93b8087c3b254d9da8d6e163659d467e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/03d554de45574c7c8830cdedca8b0769/images/93b8087c3b254d9da8d6e163659d467eCapture.PNG)

### Community Post Comments:


Comment 2: Hi There. If you want to use the Normal map that is from the applied fabric you do not add a normal map to the graphic, instead you check the box directly below that says "Use same Map as Fabric"Also from your screenshot I do see something added to the Normal Map area. But it is just a white box (possibly has a texture I cannot see) but that is not a normal Map either way. Normal Maps have a bluish/purplish color similar to screenshot for a normal map brick attached below
Reply 1: Thanks for your help Ariel I will check those out and give it a go!
